title: A Butterfly-Accelerated Manifold Harmonic Transform
summary: The eigenfunctions of the Laplacian are a natural basis of functions for many tasks in computational mathematics. On the circle and sphere, the eigenfunctions are given by complex periodic exponentials and spherical harmonics, respectively, and much work has been done to develop fast algorithms for analyzing and synthesizing data in these bases. In this work, we generalize these special-case transforms to Laplace-Beltrami eigenfunctions of arbitrary surfaces, referred to as manifold harmonics.
